name: Filter coffee (South Indian coffee decoction with milk and sugar)

source.name: Hebbar's Kitchen (hebbarskitchen.com)
source.license: Ingredient amounts as listed in the cited recipe, converted to grams; nutrients composed from USDA FoodData Central (CC0)

notes: Serves 4. Decoction (3 tbsp coffee powder in 1.5 cups water) taken as USDA brewed coffee; the recipe pours about a quarter glass of decoction per serving, taken as ~37 g each (150 g for 4), the rest of the decoction kept for later. 1.5 cups whole milk 366 g, boiled, about 12 g lost as steam; 4 tsp sugar 16 g. Chicory in the powder is not modelled.
